implementation.coverage: 19 obligations use these registrations. One original scalar beta-min obligation reuses existing registered scalar-soft-threshold with z=1/4,tau=1/2; its objective is twice the original n=1 empirical Lasso objective, so minimizers agree. independence.fairness: Enumerate feature/outcome/bin atoms from a,p,X; sum calibration residuals, class masses, conditional score means, moments, exact threshold-event masses. Endpoint threshold areas are obtained by integrating survival step functions interval by interval, rather than returning the stated mean formula.
independence.schur: Compute2x2 eigenvalues from characteristic roots and conditional variance/inverse columns by independent pivoted elimination.
independence.ols_ridge_lasso: Build Gram/right-hand side from raw X,y, solve ridge by Gaussian elimination, and exhaustively evaluate raw objective grids. Joint orthonormal fixture checks both coordinates and the exact one-sided derivative boundary with 1/(2n) normalization. Duplicate-column Lasso checks the entire bounded grid minimizer segment, including endpoints.
independence.gaussian: For five even scalar sample sizes independently integrate the rescaled chi-square density on a finite numerical domain and compare its deviation tail with the claimed Chernoff envelope; verify normalization and decreasing tails. It does not return the envelope as the model probability.
independence.scheduled_scale: Numerically evaluate the defining n_k,s_k,N_k and lambda_n schedules for six fixed k, then compare the actual active-fluctuation term against the proposed proxy; check finite growth and decreasing relative proxy error. These are floating-point probes, not exact arbitrary-precision evaluations of huge rounded integers.

bounded_limits: All passes are finite-model falsification checks only. Gaussian quadrature and schedule probes do not certify probability convergence, asymptotic divergence, support-recovery rates, covariance concentration in varying dimension, arbitrary optimization domains or any general theorem. Original result descriptions remain intact; no finite obligation has been deleted or replaced by a general proof claim.
